codeserver.description: A code-server container to edit the files of the app.

gluetun.description: A gluetun VPN container that routes the traffic of the pod.

netshoot.description: A netshoot container to debug the network of the pod.

tailscale.description: A tailscale container that connects the pod to a tailnet.

type.description: Legacy vpn add-on type. Not used, rendering fails when `addons.vpn` is set.

env.description: Legacy environment variables for the vpn add-on. Not used, rendering fails when `addons.vpn` is set.

targetSelector.description: Legacy workloads for the vpn add-on. Not used, rendering fails when `addons.vpn` is set.

config.description: Legacy configuration for the vpn add-on. Not used, rendering fails when `addons.vpn` is set.

up.description: Legacy script run when the vpn connects. Not used, rendering fails when `addons.vpn` is set.

down.description: Legacy script run when the vpn disconnects. Not used, rendering fails when `addons.vpn` is set.

scripts.description: Legacy scripts for the vpn add-on. Not used, rendering fails when `addons.vpn` is set.

vpn.description: Removed vpn add-on. Setting `addons.vpn` fails rendering (see `templates/values/_deprecations.tpl`), use `addons.gluetun` or `addons.tailscale` instead.
